method: linear measurement of a preserved specimen; Materials and methods > Morphology and taxonomy prints 'Measurements and counts of morphological characters were taken using a Neiko digital caliper rounded to the nearest 0.1 mm under a Leica Stemi 2000 stereoscope' and lists 'eye diameter (EYD (eye diameter))' among the additional measurements taken only for the description of the holotype; the Methods give no further definition of the eye diameter
conditions: Adult female holotype of Bolitoglossa muisca sp. nov. Type material as printed: holotype IAvH-Am-17413, an adult female from Finca La Esmeralda, vereda Roble Hueco, Bojacá municipality, Cundinamarca department, Colombia (4.6963, -74.3624, 2630 m a.s.l.), collected by Y.R. López-Perilla on 4 February 2021. Value is for the holotype only: the paper prints no eye diameter for any paratype (Table 2, 'Meristic data and measurements of the type series of Bolitoglossa muisca', has no eye diameter row). Unit mm is printed in the quote and in the same sentence (SVL = 61.3 mm, SNL = 3.1 mm) and the 0.1 mm precision statement; the value is printed to 0.01 mm. The sentence is one very long semicolon-joined sentence; the quote keeps its opening words and the clause carrying the eye diameter, with both cuts marked [...]. The eyes are described there as large and 'smaller than interorbital distance' (IOD = 3.37 mm).
